title: What the Scan Sees
endLine: A scan shows what the gland traps, not what blood carries.

scenes.tts: The first film showed tissues switching T four on, to T three. But T four is built in the gland, from iodine. Here is a thyroid scan, glowing. Does a bright gland mean plenty of hormone in the blood?
scenes.narration: The first film showed tissues switching T4 on, to T3. But T4 is built in the gland, from iodine. Here is a thyroid scan, glowing. Does a bright gland mean plenty of hormone in the blood?
scenes.caption: The first film showed tissues switching T4 on, to T3. But T4 is built in the gland, from iodine. Here is a thyroid scan, glowing. Does a bright gland mean plenty of hormone in the blood?
scenes.visual: Continue the first film's 16:9 world and COLOUR MAP without a reset: BLUE = T4; GREEN = T3; YELLOW = iodine (here, small YELLOW dots of ordinary iodide); ORANGE = the radioactive label (here, ORANGE tracer dots and the ORANGE scan glow); PINK = the MCT8 transporter; PURPLE = deiodinases; GREY = glands, cells, blood, outlines. New in this film: CYAN = the NIS door on the blood side of follicle cells; MAGENTA = TSH from the pituitary. A small 'schematic' tag sits at bottom right all film; no uptake numbers appear anywhere. OPENING (link-back sentences): a ghost of the first film's GREY tissue cell at left, a BLUE T4 dot entering through a PINK door and a PURPLE D2 turning it GREEN, labelled 'last time'. On 'built in the gland', the ghost fades and the camera swings to the neck: a large GREY two-lobed thyroid outline (butterfly shape) fills about 65% of the frame height, a GREY blood vessel running beside it with BLUE dots drifting along. On 'a thyroid scan, glowing', both lobes fill with an even ORANGE glow that slowly shimmers. On the question, large white text appears above the gland: 'Bright = more hormone?' A small GREY blood gauge labelled 'blood hormone' sits at right with its needle hidden behind a YELLOW question mark.
Title 'What the Scan Sees' fades in above the glowing gland for 2 s while the question text fades out. The ORANGE glow keeps shimmering; BLUE dots keep drifting in the vessel.

scenes.tts: Zoom into one follicle: a hollow ball of cells around a protein gel, the colloid. Each cell faces blood on one side and colloid on the other. On the blood side, the sodium-iodide symporter, N I S, pulls iodide in.
scenes.narration: Zoom into one follicle: a hollow ball of cells around a protein gel, the colloid. Each cell faces blood on one side and colloid on the other. On the blood side, the sodium-iodide symporter, NIS, pulls iodide in.
scenes.caption: Zoom into one follicle: a hollow ball of cells around a protein gel, the colloid. Each cell faces blood on one side and colloid on the other. On the blood side, the sodium-iodide symporter, NIS, pulls iodide in.
scenes.visual: The ORANGE glow dims to a faint wash and the camera dives into one lobe until a single follicle fills about 70% of the frame height: a ring of about ten GREY cube-shaped cells around a central lumen of translucent pale GREY gel labelled 'colloid'. A GREY capillary curves around the outside of the ring, BLUE and YELLOW dots drifting in it, labelled 'blood'. On 'faces blood on one side', the outer (blood) faces of the cells glow GREY-white; on 'colloid on the other', the inner faces glow. On 'N I S', small CYAN doors appear on the blood face of every cell, labelled 'NIS' once; YELLOW iodide dots pass through the CYAN doors from blood into the cells, one by one, and gather inside. No molecular structures; no stoichiometry on screen.

scenes.tts: At the colloid face, the enzyme thyroperoxidase fixes iodine onto a large protein, thyroglobulin. Iodinated pieces join into T four and T three, still on the protein. Driven by T S H, the cell later takes colloid back in. Mostly T four leaves, through transporters such as M C T eight.
scenes.narration: At the colloid face, the enzyme thyroperoxidase fixes iodine onto a large protein, thyroglobulin. Iodinated pieces join into T4 and T3, still on the protein. Driven by TSH, the cell later takes colloid back in. Mostly T4 leaves, through transporters such as MCT8.
scenes.caption: At the colloid face, the enzyme thyroperoxidase fixes iodine onto a large protein, thyroglobulin. Iodinated pieces join into T4 and T3, still on the protein. Driven by TSH, the cell later takes colloid back in. Mostly T4 leaves, through transporters such as MCT8.
scenes.visual: Camera holds on the follicle; one cell is highlighted, the rest stay visible. YELLOW dots cross the highlighted cell to its colloid face. On 'thyroperoxidase', a small WHITE spark marker labelled 'TPO' sits on that face; YELLOW dots stick onto long pale GREY strands in the colloid labelled 'thyroglobulin' (plain strands, no structure). On 'join into T four and T three', short segments of the strands turn BLUE (most) and GREEN (a few), still attached to the strands. On 'T S H', a MAGENTA arrow labelled 'TSH' reaches the blood face from the edge of the frame. On 'takes colloid back in', a bubble of colloid with BLUE and GREEN segments pinches into the cell and shrinks (digested). On 'Mostly T four leaves', BLUE dots (many) and a few GREEN dots exit the blood face through PINK doors labelled 'MCT8' into the capillary. The 'thyroglobulin' and 'TPO' labels fade by the end of the scene so no more than six labelled things show.

scenes.tts: A scan borrows the first step. A small tracer dose of radioactive iodine is given, commonly iodine one twenty-three. N I S carries it in along with ordinary iodide. Hours later, a camera measures what fraction the gland holds, and where.
scenes.narration: A scan borrows the first step. A small tracer dose of radioactive iodine is given, commonly iodine-123. NIS carries it in along with ordinary iodide. Hours later, a camera measures what fraction the gland holds, and where.
scenes.caption: A scan borrows the first step. A small tracer dose of radioactive iodine is given, commonly iodine-123. NIS carries it in along with ordinary iodide. Hours later, a camera measures what fraction the gland holds, and where.
scenes.visual: On 'borrows the first step', the CYAN NIS doors pulse. On 'radioactive iodine', ORANGE dots labelled 'tracer (iodine-123)' appear in the capillary, mixed among the YELLOW iodide dots. On 'carries it in', ORANGE and YELLOW dots pass through the CYAN doors together into the cells and on toward the colloid; ORANGE dots that reach the colloid make it glow faintly ORANGE. On 'Hours later', a small clock icon in the corner sweeps; the camera pulls back out of the follicle to the whole two-lobed gland, now glowing ORANGE again, and a GREY camera head descends above the neck labelled 'scan camera'. On 'and where', the glow resolves into a map across both lobes. No percentage or number is shown: label 'fraction held' only.

scenes.tts: Here is the one idea. Uptake reports how much tracer the gland is still holding. That depends on trapping, on fixing iodine to protein, and on the iodide supply. It does not measure the hormone in the blood.
scenes.narration: Here is the one idea. Uptake reports how much tracer the gland is still holding. That depends on trapping, on fixing iodine to protein, and on the iodide supply. It does not measure the hormone in the blood.
scenes.caption: Here is the one idea. Uptake reports how much tracer the gland is still holding. That depends on trapping, on fixing iodine to protein, and on the iodide supply. It does not measure the hormone in the blood.
scenes.visual: Split the same world: the ORANGE-glowing gland at left fills about 60% of the frame height; the GREY blood vessel with its 'blood hormone' gauge sits at right, BLUE dots drifting. On 'trapping', the CYAN doors flash on a small inset follicle at the gland's edge; on 'fixing iodine to protein', the colloid strands flash YELLOW; on 'iodide supply', YELLOW dots stream in the vessel. Three short labels stack under the gland as each is named: 'trapping', 'fixing iodine', 'iodide supply'. On 'does not measure the hormone in the blood', a GREY dashed line separates gland from vessel, and the BLUE dots in the vessel do not change the ORANGE glow. Large white line at top: 'Uptake = tracer held'.

scenes.tts: The tracer never travels alone. Ordinary iodide from the diet rides in beside it, through the same doors. Now suppose a large iodine load arrives, such as contrast dye. Does uptake rise or fall?
scenes.narration: The tracer never travels alone. Ordinary iodide from the diet rides in beside it, through the same doors. Now suppose a large iodine load arrives, such as contrast dye. Does uptake rise or fall?
scenes.caption: The tracer never travels alone. Ordinary iodide from the diet rides in beside it, through the same doors. Now suppose a large iodine load arrives, such as contrast dye. Does uptake rise or fall?
scenes.visual: Back into the follicle view. In the capillary, a steady mix of many YELLOW and some ORANGE dots passes through the CYAN doors. On 'a large iodine load arrives', a dense wave of YELLOW dots floods the capillary from the left, labelled 'iodine load'; the ORANGE tracer dots are the same number as before. The follicle and lobe glow are held at their current brightness, not yet changed. Question card at top in white: 'Uptake: rise or fall?'
Predict pause. The question card stays. The YELLOW flood keeps drifting slowly in the capillary with the same few ORANGE dots among it; the CYAN doors stay still; the glow holds. No other change.

scenes.tts: It falls, partly because the flood of ordinary iodide dilutes the tracer. Now flip it: a diet short of iodine. Little ordinary iodide competes, so uptake runs high. Yet blood T four can be falling.
scenes.narration: It falls, partly because the flood of ordinary iodide dilutes the tracer. Now flip it: a diet short of iodine. Little ordinary iodide competes, so uptake runs high. Yet blood T4 can be falling.
scenes.caption: It falls, partly because the flood of ordinary iodide dilutes the tracer. Now flip it: a diet short of iodine. Little ordinary iodide competes, so uptake runs high. Yet blood T4 can be falling.
scenes.visual: Question card dissolves. On 'It falls', the CYAN doors pass mostly YELLOW dots and rarely an ORANGE one; the colloid's ORANGE glow fades, and a small inset of the whole gland dims, labelled 'lower uptake'. On 'flip it', the YELLOW flood drains away until only a few YELLOW dots remain, labelled 'iodine short'; now nearly every dot passing the CYAN doors is ORANGE, and the colloid and the gland inset glow bright ORANGE, labelled 'high uptake'. On 'Yet blood T four can be falling', the 'blood hormone' gauge returns at right, the YELLOW question mark lifts off it, and its BLUE needle drifts down while the gland glows bright: a bright scan beside a falling gauge. Schematic, no numbers.

scenes.tts: The scan also shows where. In a toxic adenoma, one nodule makes hormone on its own. The extra hormone suppresses the pituitary's T S H. Without that drive, the rest of the gland takes up little tracer.
scenes.narration: The scan also shows where. In a toxic adenoma, one nodule makes hormone on its own. The extra hormone suppresses the pituitary's TSH. Without that drive, the rest of the gland takes up little tracer.
scenes.caption: The scan also shows where. In a toxic adenoma, one nodule makes hormone on its own. The extra hormone suppresses the pituitary's TSH. Without that drive, the rest of the gland takes up little tracer.
scenes.visual: Camera pulls back to the whole two-lobed gland under the scan camera; iodide supply returns to its usual mix. A small GREY pituitary sits at top right with a MAGENTA TSH arrow running down to the gland. On 'one nodule', a round nodule in the lower right lobe brightens ORANGE and sends extra BLUE dots into the vessel; the 'blood hormone' gauge needle rises. On 'suppresses', a BLUE arrow from the vessel reaches the pituitary and the MAGENTA TSH arrow thins and fades. On 'takes up little tracer', the rest of both lobes dims to a faint ORANGE while the nodule stays bright. Label beside it: 'one bright nodule'.

scenes.tts: So the scan is read with the blood tests, never alone. The blood tests report the hormone level. The scan reports what the gland is doing with iodide, and where.
scenes.narration: So the scan is read with the blood tests, never alone. The blood tests report the hormone level. The scan reports what the gland is doing with iodide, and where.
scenes.caption: So the scan is read with the blood tests, never alone. The blood tests report the hormone level. The scan reports what the gland is doing with iodide, and where.
scenes.visual: The nodule picture slides left and shrinks to half the frame; the 'blood hormone' gauge and the vessel with BLUE dots sit at right at matching size. On 'read with the blood tests', a white bracket joins the two halves, labelled 'read together'. On 'report the hormone', the gauge glows; on 'what the gland is doing with iodide, and where', the ORANGE scan glows and YELLOW and ORANGE dots flow into it.

scenes.tts: A bright gland is a busy trap, not a full bloodstream. The scan pictures tracer held in the gland, not hormone in the blood.
scenes.narration: A bright gland is a busy trap, not a full bloodstream. The scan pictures tracer held in the gland, not hormone in the blood.
scenes.caption: A bright gland is a busy trap, not a full bloodstream. The scan pictures tracer held in the gland, not hormone in the blood.
scenes.visual: Return to the opening picture: the full two-lobed gland, both lobes glowing evenly ORANGE, the vessel beside it with BLUE dots drifting. On 'a busy trap', the camera eases in so CYAN doors on the gland's edge pull YELLOW and ORANGE dots inward; on 'not a full bloodstream', the BLUE dots in the vessel pulse once without changing the glow. The opening line 'Bright = more hormone?' reappears briefly, crossed through, then fades.

End card over the dimmed but still moving world (ORANGE and YELLOW dots drifting into the glowing gland, BLUE dots moving along the vessel). Large centred white text: 'A scan shows what the gland traps, not what blood carries.'
